title: Advent Calendar Racing Cars – 24 Cars Behind 24 Doors
descriptionHtml:
The chocolate calendar is gone by December 2

The calendar opens in thirty seconds, the chocolate is eaten before breakfast, and nothing is left of it for the rest of the day. The next morning it's the same thing again. Twenty-four days, twenty-four things that disappear right away.

Something that's still on the floor afterwards

Behind every door stands a car. The first one is driven around the kitchen table while the porridge is eaten, and the twenty-fourth parks next to the other twenty-three. What started as a morning routine has become a garage by Christmas Eve.

Features

  • Something to play with, not just eat up – 24 cars behind 24 doors
  • The collection grows all through December – every car is its own model and color
  • Made for floor play, not just unpacking – wheels that really roll
  • Works as a gift in itself – comes in a ready-made gift box

Contains small parts. Not suitable for children under 3 years.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
